title: Sapphire Sunset | KEY.co
description_expanded: Upstairs, the luxury continues with two king-sized bedrooms, each boasting its ensuite bathroom for ultimate privacy and comfort. The home’s crown jewel is the primary master suite, featuring breathtaking views from a private balcony, a sumptuous daybed, and a lavish ensuite with a soaking tub and glass shower. For younger guests, a spacious bunk room offers cozy sleeping quarters and a lounge area for relaxation and play. The newly designed outdoor area is a sanctuary in itself, featuring a custom plunge pool, a summer kitchen with a covered gas grill, and ample space for dining and leisure, making every moment at this home an unforgettable experience of comfort and luxury. This exquisite two-story modern residence offers an elegant escape with its blend of contemporary décor and sunlit, expansive living areas. The heart of the home features a striking floor-to-ceiling seashell tabby gas fireplace, complemented by whitewashed wood floors and soaring 12-foot ceilings adorned with stunning glass chandeliers. The living space flows seamlessly into a state-of-the-art gourmet kitchen, where a large marble island and premium appliances like a Wolf gas range and Subzero refrigerator meet the needs of culinary enthusiasts. The adjacent dining room, with its custom benches and seating for eight, provides a perfect setting for delightful gatherings.
